page.content:
Chinese assassin clan that produced the Sub-Zeros.

How Lin Kuei connects

  • Character: Sub-Zero — Sub-Zero is the cryomancer face of the Lin Kuei.
  • Faction: Shirai Ryu — The Lin Kuei and Shirai Ryu are rival assassin clans.
  • Location: Earthrealm — The Lin Kuei are an Earthrealm assassin clan.

What is Lin Kuei?

The Lin Kuei are the cryomancer assassins of Earthrealm, the clan that made Sub-Zero, Cyber Lin Kuei conversions, and the murder that created Scorpion's vendetta.

Key threads lead to Sub-Zero, Shirai Ryu and Earthrealm.
